overview: AI agents accelerate product development and integration, cutting weeks to days.
Enterprise tools leverage Codex to speed code creation and analysis, boosting decision speed.
Open-source and specialized models see rapid adoption, highlighting demand for efficient, customizable AI.

top.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
top.summary: Stack Overflow built Stack Overflow for Agents using Codex, reducing connector build time from weeks to days and boosting agent sign‑ups 10‑fold via a ChatGPT plugin.

top.title: Benefit Street Partners answers questions faster with Codex
top.summary: Benefit Street Partners used Codex and GPT‑6 Astra to create credit analysis tools, cutting development to ~12 hours and enabling near‑real‑time investment committee responses.

top.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
top.summary: Vercel reported its Jev model achieved 35% adoption among paid teams within two weeks, the fastest uptake for any model, driven by low cost and speed for classification tasks.

top.title: Welcome Beam: a 501B open model you can own, customize, and scale
top.summary: Reflection released Beam, a 501‑billion‑parameter sparse MoE model with 1 M token context, open‑source under Apache 2.0, targeting coding and agentic workloads.

top.title: Roundtables: A Conversation With the Creator of AI-Designed Viruses
top.summary: Stanford PhD student Samuel King used generative AI to design viral genetic blueprints, sparking discussion on AI‑driven synthetic biology and its limits.

top.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
top.summary: Elorian launched Glimpse, a multimodal model that iteratively crops and reasons on images, offering cheaper, more detailed visual reasoning than existing frontier models.
